name: mesh-gradient
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Mesh Gradient style. Default variant. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. Adapted from Paper Shaders under Apache-2.0. 4-color palette (#120D31, #6C4CF1, #EF5DA8, #FFD166). A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
